title: A plant's water route
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Water absorbed by roots moves through xylem toward leaves. Transpiration at the leaf helps pull water along this route; the drawing omits the branching vessels.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain xylem from root to leaf in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In a transpiring plant, water absorbed by roots travels through xylem toward which structure? Water absorbed by roots moves through xylem toward leaves. Transpiration at the leaf helps pull water along this route; the drawing omits the branching vessels.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
